entities.name: EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure using EAP-AKA' where AUSF/AAA server sends EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message with AT_KDF_INPUT set to SNN and may include AT_RESULT_IND attribute.

entities.name: EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message
entities.description: EAP message sent by AUSF/AAA server containing AT_KDF_INPUT attribute set to SNN and optionally AT_RESULT_IND attribute.

entities.name: AT_KDF_INPUT attribute
entities.description: EAP attribute containing network name field set to SNN for key derivation function input.

entities.name: AT_RESULT_IND attribute
entities.description: Optional EAP attribute that may be included in EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message.

entities.name: SNN
entities.description: Serving Network Name in format described in subclause 9.12.1, used as input for AT_KDF_INPUT attribute.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Next Generation Key Set Identifier selected by network and sent to UE along with each EAP message.

entities.name: ABBA value
entities.description: Anti-Bidding Down Between Architectures value sent to UE along with EAP request and EAP-success messages.

entities.name: Network name check condition
entities.description: UE checks if network name field of AT_KDF_INPUT matches SNN constructed per 9.12.1 and matches PLMN/SNPN identity of selected network.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management idle state where UE uses PLMN identity of selected PLMN for network name check.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management connected state where UE uses specific PLMN/SNPN identity for network name check based on handover and cell conditions.

relations.description: Procedure initiation involves sending EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message.
EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message contains AT_KDF_INPUT attribute set to SNN.
EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message may optionally contain AT_RESULT_IND attribute.
AT_KDF_INPUT attribute contains SNN as network name field.
Procedure involves network selecting ngKSI value and sending it to UE with each EAP message.
Procedure involves sending ABBA value to UE with EAP request and EAP-success messages.
Network name check condition verifies AT_KDF_INPUT attribute's network name field matches SNN and selected network identity.
Network name check uses PLMN identity of selected PLMN when UE moves from 5GMM-IDLE to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
Network name check uses specific PLMN/SNPN identity based on handover and cell conditions in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
